ModMetaData.name: No Lethal Damage Threshold Forked (xytyyy)
ModMetaData.author: Jdalt40
ModMetaData.description: Did you know pawns can only have a total of 150 damage across all body parts before the pawn dies for no reason? This mod fixes that by telling ShouldBeDeadFromLethalDamageThreshold to go **** itself! Should be compatible with all mods and is save compatible!
